name: Garden of the Sleeping Giant
bio_draft: Garden: former private orchid nursery of Raymond Burr with hilly walking paths and tropical plantings; entry charged.

name: Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple
bio_draft: Religious site: large Dravidian-style Hindu temple at the southern end of Nadi; visitors cover up and enter the interior, free to enter.

name: Sabeto Hot Springs and Mud Pool
bio_draft: Natural attraction: mud bath and three hot-spring pools in the Sabeto valley near Nadi; mud treatments and massages offered.

name: Koroyanitu National Heritage Park
bio_draft: Park: 35 km2 heritage park around Mount Koroyanitu behind Lautoka and Nadi, with walking trails from Abaca village.

name: Viseisei Village
bio_draft: Village: the oldest settlement in Fiji, said to be where the first Melanesian canoes beached at nearby Vuda Point; a $5 entry fee applies.

name: Wailoaloa Beach
bio_draft: Beach: 3 km sand beach north of Nadi town, lined with resorts and beach clubs; a swimming and sunset spot.
